name: wasp-dev
description: WASP (Workspace-Aware Spec-based Publisher) — a fork of bee-dev that ships the upstream bee and nectar plugins (both vendored unmodified) alongside a wasp plugin layering an audit-to-publish lifecycle (audit-prep, bundle/unify-audit-specs, pollinate, cross-pollinate) on top. A single install gives you spec-driven development (bee), skills-based autonomous delivery (nectar), and workspace-aware cascade publishing (wasp).

plugins.name: bee
plugins.description: Vendored unmodified from upstream bee-dev 1.11.0 (bee plugin 4.8.2). Spec-driven development workflow with review gates, the Bee Hive local dashboard, and a live agent activity feed powered by Claude Code hooks — take features from idea to commit and watch tool calls stream in real time. All upstream /bee:* commands work exactly as in the original.

plugins.name: nectar
plugins.description: Vendored unmodified from upstream bee-dev 1.11.0 (nectar plugin 1.0.0). The essence of spec-driven development distilled into 9 skills and 3 enforcement agents — shape, plan, build, review, honey, debug, audit, capture, orient. No commands, no state machine: plain artifacts in docs/work/ are the only state, discipline is enforced by read-only agents and fresh contexts, and 'drop the honey' delivers a feature end-to-end from a single confirmation.

plugins.name: wasp
plugins.description: Workspace-Aware Spec-based Publisher — additive layer on top of bee. Adds /wasp:audit-prep, /wasp:bundle-audit-specs, /wasp:unify-audit-specs, /wasp:pollinate (multi-package monorepo aware), /wasp:cross-pollinate (cross-repository cascade across a workspace), and /wasp:master-pollinate (tier-1 cascade across a SUITE of workspaces and GitHub orgs, delegating each workspace's cascade to cross-pollinate).
